title: Az Alaptörvény születése és hatálybalépése (The Birth & Promulgation of the Fundamental Law)
grammar: Constitutional Regimes, Rights Guarantees & Legal Terminology in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when the Fundamental Law was adopted and when it came into force.
I can explain what the historical constitution was.
I can use verbs such as kihirdet and hatályba lép.
I can read a short text about the birth of the Fundamental Law and answer questions about it.
